omitted.reason: Fleet-wide bulk import scan exposed for programmatic/automation callers (consumed by SDA and fleet-planning tooling over Connect); it has no clean single-target CLI form alongside the per-target facts commands, so it is intentionally not bound to a CLI command.

domains.reason: Fact queries are deterministic evidence reads; cache hit metadata records reuse without changing requested evidence semantics.
Cache status, inspect, and clear expose operational state and dry-run mutation counts.
